The '''Industrial mineral scanner''' was a model of scanner made by [[Crozo Industrial Products/Legends|Crozo Industrial Products]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The device cost 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" /> The mineral scanner could send out a 100-meter pulse in all directions that would survey the area for nearby minerals. Lower concentrations of minerals would show up faded on the data screen, whereas higher concentrations would show up more solid.

==Behind the scenes==
The Industrial mineral scanner was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
